name: tietu-toutiao
description: A WeChat pictorial-post editor for media teams and creators, producing traceable image groups, captions and local delivery bundles with legacy cover continuity.

displayDescription.en: Turns newspapers, reports, photos and notes into ordered pictorial posts with independent captions, scoped revisions and source-aware previews.
displayDescription.zh: 面向微信贴图号，优先帮助媒体编辑，也支持创作者，把报道与照片制成有序图组、配文和可核查作品。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 上传这张报纸版面，生成 3 个贴图头条方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: Upload this newspaper page and create three Tietu Toutiao cover concepts.

quickPrompts.en: Upload this newspaper page and create three Tietu Toutiao cover concepts.
quickPrompts.zh: 上传这张报纸版面，生成 3 个贴图头条方案

quickPrompts.en: Turn these newspaper pages or photos into a WeChat pictorial post with images and a caption.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这批报道或照片做成微信贴图作品，带图组和配文

quickPrompts.en: Revise the previous version: tell me what you are not happy with.
quickPrompts.zh: 修改上一版：说哪里不满意就行
